stem.text: A wooden cylinder floats partially submerged in a bath of water. A force $F$ is applied to the cylinder until it is just fully submerged.

stem.alt: Wooden cylinder floating partly submerged in water, labelled water and wooden cylinder.
Wooden cylinder fully submerged in water, with a downward arrow labelled F acting on it.

A.text: Some of the water gains gravitational potential energy.

B.text: The cylinder loses gravitational potential energy.

C.text: Work is done by force $F$ on the cylinder.

D.text: Work is done by the upthrust on the cylinder.
